newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines charges two men in major drug bust.
newsitem.headline: Philippines charges two men in major drug bust.

text.p: Police have filed drug possession charges against two Filipino Chinese men after confiscating $19 million worth of stimulants from them in one of the Philippines' biggest drug seizures, officials said on Sunday.
Police arrested the pair after chasing their van through streets in a Manila suburb on Friday. Officers found the drugs after searching the vehicle, a police press statement said.
The drugs, called methamphetamine hydrochloride or "ice", were in nine sacks and weighed 253 kgs (556 lb), it said.

The suspect who drove the van was also charged with reckless imprudence after hitting a boy during the chase, Senior Inspector Bartolome Bustamante told reporters. The boy was being treated in hospital for a broken leg.
Possession of more than 200 grams of "ice" is punishable by death under Philippine law.

The charges against the two Filipino Chinese were filed on Saturday night with the state prosecutor's office. Under the Philippine legal system, the prosecutor must first assess if there is enough evidence against a suspect to warrant bringing the case to court for trial.
Police in November arrested a Hong Kong Chinese man and seized $25 million worth of morphine and methamphetamine stimulants in a raid on a house in nearby Tagaytay city.
